title: Tone ID.
summary: Play a word, ask which tone each syllable was, cycling every installed Chinese voice. Best transfer evidence on the ranked list: perception-only training moved learners' actual production 18%. A fifth face of the v101 retrieval engine. No model call, no network, no new table.
settled: An item is a whole word and the learner answers EVERY syllable's tone (not single-syllable-only).
Neutral is a real answer on every syllable: the answer set is five. 20% of HSK 1 words contain a neutral syllable, against 3% affected by sandhi.

Sandhi is taught, not excluded: 你好 is answered 2-3. Todd verified iOS voices apply it, by listening. Evidence is iOS only, so the rule must degrade and never punish a learner who hears a citation tone.
A round is 20 items by default and ships as a SETTING, not a constant.
Credit goes in its own counter under face "toneid" and touches neither GHOST_USES nor the pacing arithmetic.
Audio is the device's own voices. OpenRouter audio models and Pleco were both examined and ruled out; do not re-raise either.
